title: TRICARE Select Enrollment Fee Billing and Installment Amounts
content:
**Billing basis.** Enrollment fees of **TRICARE Select** are owed only by tiers that are not fee-exempt (the retiree tiers) and are billed once per sponsor family to the fee-bearing enrollment - the sponsor's own Select enrollment when the sponsor is enrolled, otherwise that of the eldest enrolled family member. An annual installment is the full annual fee, a quarterly installment one quarter and a monthly installment one twelfth, each rounded to the cent; installments cover calendar quarters or calendar months and are due on the first day of the period they cover. A first installment for an enrollment that starts mid-period covers the months from the month containing the effective date (counted whole) to the end of that installment period, at one twelfth of the annual fee per month, and is charged with the application. A fee-bearing enrollment is activated only after its first installment charge has a payment posted against it. Installments are charged only on a fee-bearing enrollment whose status is applied or active.

> **Retired clause, no longer in force.** The clause "The family owes the individual annual fee while exactly one member is enrolled in Select and the family annual fee while two or more are." has been withdrawn and superseded by the current basis for the annual fee an installment is figured from.

## Installment amounts

On a tier that is not fee-exempt, each installment is figured from the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (individual or family):

| Frequency | Installment | Rounding |
|---|---|---|
| annual | the full annual fee | to the cent |
| quarterly | the annual fee divided by 4 | to the cent |
| monthly | the annual fee divided by 12 (the monthly rate) | to the cent |

Hypothetical figures on an annual fee of 595.08: quarterly 148.77, monthly 49.59. On 1190.16: quarterly 297.54, monthly 99.18.

## Mid-period first installment (hypothetical)

A quarterly enrollment effective 2026-05-20 has a first installment covering May and June (May counted whole): two months at one twelfth of a hypothetical annual fee of 198.00, that is 16.50 a month, 33.00, charged with the application.

## Conditions on charging and activation

| Action | Condition, read from the system record for that enrollment |
|---|---|
| Charging an installment | the enrollment is fee-bearing and its status is applied or active |
| Activating a fee-bearing enrollment | its first installment charge has a payment posted against it |

superseded_clauses: The family owes annual_fee_individual while exactly one member is enrolled in Select and annual_fee_family while two or more are.
